bug.title: The promotion store bootstraps from each migration's statements() but the migration chain applies upgrade(), so the two schemas diverge on 0118's node index
bug.symptoms: The two paths differ on one index: - promotion.schema bootstrap_schema / bootstrap_calibration_schema / the decision bootstrap run _statements_for(order), which is every owner revision's statements(dialect). - Since dc52090, 0118_node_table.upgrade(connection) also re-runs 0113's index upgrade, so the migrated chain carries node_campaign_id_parent_id. The store-first database never gets it, and the module's own convergence test fails. The effect is one index missing in a store-created database, which is a performance gap, not a correctness one.
bug.reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=src:packages/promotion/src uv run --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider packages/promotion/tests/test_promotion_pre_register.py -k converge
bug.expected: - The store runs each owner migration the way the chain does, keeping the module's rule that "the migration is the author". - For each owner revision it calls that migration's own upgrade(connection) (or upgrade(connection, dialect), whichever the revision's signature takes) inside the store's existing transaction, instead of executing statements(). - It never authors, selects or edits a statement itself. - bootstrap_schema and its siblings still return the DDL that ran: the concatenation of the upgrade() return values. - Every owner's upgrade is idempotent, and that stays true for this store: calling the bootstrap on a fully migrated database changes no table and no index (the existing "left exactly as it was" test). - The store-first and migrated-first schemas are identical. test_the_store_and_the_migrations_converge_either_way_round passes unchanged. - New test_schema_owner_upgrade.py covers: - each bootstrap's returned DDL contains node_campaign_id_parent_id when 0118 is an owner - a second bootstrap is a no-op - an owner upgrade that raises surfaces as the store's existing PromotionStoreError, naming the revision It passes under pytest-xdist. - The promotion member suite is fully green (it is 578 passed, 1 failed today). The root tests/ suite passes.
bug.actual: Root cause: promotion.schema treats statements() as the migration's whole effect, but 0118's upgrade() does more than its statements() list.
bug.constraints: No migration file is edited No file outside the three listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/
